Stackpole]]. It is the eighth volume of the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'' novel series]], and it was first published in paperback by [[Bantam Spectra]] on [[April 13]], [[1999]]. An [[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge (abridged audiobook)|abridged audiobook]] version was also published. The novel is set in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], and it follows the events of the previous ''X-Wing'' novel, ''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]'', as well as the events of [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|''The Thrawn Trilogy'']]. A sequel, ''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]'', was written by [[Aaron Allston]].
